name: SEB SA
reason: Small-appliance/cookware maker with adjusted EPS (EUR) down from 8.36 in 2021 to 4.45 in 2025 (0.53x 10y max, -39% in 2024), EBIT margin 7.1% at the 18th pctile under Chinese competition and net debt/EBITDA 2.8x; cheap but no moat or secular driver.

name: Aryzta AG
reason: Turnaround convenience bakery whose adjusted EPS (EUR) collapsed from 33.58 (2015) to 4.33 (2025) with a 9.1%/yr share-count rise and -6.6% 10y avg ROIC; commodity-input, low-moat food manufacturing with no specialness.

name: CIE Automotive SA
reason: Well-run auto-parts supplier (EPS EUR 0.92 to 2.82 over 2015-25) but earnings are tied to global auto volumes, EPS is 1.0x its 10y max with EBIT margin 13.9% at the 100th pctile (near-cyclical-peak rule) and acquisitions consumed 66% of 10y FCF.

name: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE
reason: Levered mall REIT with net debt/EBITDA 12.1x, FFO/share (EUR) 9.58 in 2025 still below 13.44 in 2019, consensus FY1 -3.4% and LTG ~1%; fails the growth and balance-sheet tests.

name: ID Logistics Group
reason: Founder-led contract logistics grower (EPS EUR 3.69 to 9.73, 2015-25) but EBIT margin is only 4.2% with 5.2% 10y avg ROIC, and the FCF-route pass rests on IFRS 16-inflated FCF (NTM FCFPS ~3x EPS, 10y FCF conversion 4.9x) while P/E is 23.6x.

name: Altarea SCA
reason: Property developer/retail landlord with net debt/EBITDA 11.2x, adjusted EPS (EUR) down from 14.36 (2018) to 5.82 (2025) and shares +5.9%/yr; earnings set by the French residential/rate cycle.

name: Bouygues SA
reason: Construction/telecom/media conglomerate with 3.3% EBIT margin, 5.7% 10y avg ROIC and acquisitions at 1.23x 10y FCF (Equans); EPS (EUR) 3.07 in 2025 is barely above 3.11 in 2018 - cheap but ordinary.

name: H. Lundbeck A/S
reason: CNS pharma whose consensus EPS (DKK) growth is +0.5% FY2 and -6.1% FY3 as key products face patent expiry, after acquisitions consumed 88% of 10y FCF; no credible >=7% route and foundation-controlled.

name: HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited
reason: Listed private-equity fund of funds whose earnings are NAV marks set by capital markets (EPS USD 13.14 in 2021, -0.82 in 2022, 4.64 in 2025); not a forecastable operating business.

name: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp.
reason: Crude tanker owner whose earnings are set by freight rates (EPS USD 0.01 in 2021 vs 4.48 in 2023; consensus FY2 -48%, FY3 -41%) - a commodity/shipping-cycle earner.

name: Cirsa Enterprises SA
reason: Blackstone-controlled gaming operator recently IPO'd with only one year of public EPS (EUR 0.43), EBIT margin 26.6% at its history high after a 2020 -37.7% margin, net debt/EBITDA 2.4x and gambling-regulation exposure across Spain/LatAm.

name: Adecco Group AG
reason: Cyclical staffing business with adjusted EPS (EUR) falling from 4.69 (2015) to 2.37 (2025), EBIT margin 2.6% at the 18th pctile, net debt/EBITDA 3.4x and AI/structural pressure on temp placement.

name: Ithaca Energy PLC
reason: North Sea oil & gas producer whose earnings are set by commodity prices and UK windfall taxation (GAAP EPS USD -0.05 in 2025 vs 1.02 in 2022; consensus FY3 -33%).

name: KSB SE & Co. KGaA
reason: Family-controlled pump/valve maker with net cash but only 2.7%/yr 10y revenue growth, 8.1% 10y avg ROIC and EBIT margin 7.4% near its 7.9% high; EPS (EUR) recovery from 6.45 (2018) to 80.47 (2025) is margin repair, not a durable >=7% route - cheap but ordinary.

name: Alvotech
reason: Biosimilar developer only just profitable (GAAP EPS USD 0.10 in 2025 after -2.60 in 2022) with net debt/EBITDA 11.3x and consensus FY1 -80%; balance sheet and pipeline-driven earnings fail the forecastability and recession tests.

name: Man Group PLC
reason: Quant/alternative asset manager whose earnings swing with performance fees and markets (EPS USD 0.49 in 2022 to 0.22 in 2023, -54%) and grew only 2.7%/yr over 10y; capital-markets earner.

name: ITV PLC
reason: UK broadcaster in structural linear-TV advertising decline: adjusted EPS (GBP) 0.16 to 0.08 over 2015-25, EBIT margin 26.1% to 13.2% and LTG ~0.7%.

name: JD Sports Fashion PLC
reason: Strong 10y record (EPS GBP 0.02 to 0.12) but EPS flat since 2021 at 0.12-0.13, EBIT margin 7.4% at the 27th pctile, heavy dependence on Nike allocation and growth now via acquisitions (Hibbett; 51% of 10y FCF) with a large adjusted-vs-GAAP gap.

name: Mitchells & Butlers plc
reason: Leveraged UK pub/restaurant operator with flat adjusted EPS (GBP 0.32 in 2015 vs 0.31 in 2025), 1.5% 10y avg ROIC, net debt/EBITDA 2.8x and consensus growth ~7% only from recovery; ordinary economics.

name: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG
reason: Cyclical automaker facing China/EV-transition and tariff pressure: EPS (EUR) 27.31 in 2022 to 11.89 in 2025, EBIT margin 7.4% (27th pctile), consensus FY1 -44% and LTG -5%.
